question: Q, R, S, T, U, V and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Y sits fourth to the left of S. R sits fourth to the right of T. Only two people sit between S and T when counted from the left of S. V is not an immediate neighbour of R or T. U is not an immediate neighbour of V. Who sits third to the right of Q?
solution:
Given:

Q, R, S, T, U, V and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

Y sits fourth to the left of S. R sits fourth to the right of T.

Only two people sit between S and T when counted from the left of S.
